requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.1 — plan today:
 - Portion-controlled plate method with daily food diary, about 1800 kcal/day.
 - Water aerobics / lap swimming 4 times a week (joining community pool again).
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Low back pain — chronic, stable; pool exercise helpful.
3. GERD — controlled.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 10/31/2025
Dietitian-led program intake. Diary: good breakfast and lunch, large dinner portions and seconds, dessert nightly.
Plan: plate method (½ vegetables, ¼ protein, ¼ starch), ~1800 kcal/day, daily paper food diary; dessert 3x/week in small portion; no seconds.
Activity: water aerobics / swimming 4x/week.
RD follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 01/19/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the plate-method diet and pool routine started in October; food diary most days, pool 3–4x/week. Adherence good most weeks.
O: Wt 88.1 kg, BMI 28.8. BP 122/70.
A/P:
1. Overweight — continue program.
2. Low back pain — improved.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 04/29/2026
Food diary reviewed: adherent most days, no seconds, dessert ~3x/week.
Adjustments: add a protein snack after swimming to curb evening hunger; keep dinner portions on the plate-method template.
Reports keeping up with swimming / water aerobics ~4x/week.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/13/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits since October. Swimming regularly, diary most days. Frustrated — weight 87.0 kg today vs 89.1 kg when she began (-2.4%) despite reported adherence. Interested in medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Postmenopausal.
O: Wt 87.0 kg, BMI 28.4. BP 120/76.
